stem.text: A sample of material is stretched by a tensile force to a point beyond its elastic limit. The tensile force is then reduced to zero. The force–extension graph is shown.

stem.alt: Force–extension graph with axes labelled force and extension and 0 at the origin. A curve with arrows, a straight line with an arrow, and dashed guide lines. Regions are labelled X, Y and Z.

stem.text: Which area represents the net work done on the sample?
